action.script:
# 数据源示例：内存占用（active + wired + compressor）
page=$(vm_stat | head -1 | grep -oE '[0-9]+')
used=$(vm_stat | awk -v p="$page" '/Pages active|Pages wired down|Pages occupied by compressor/ {gsub("\\.",""); s+=$NF} END {print s*p}')
total=$(sysctl -n hw.memsize)
fraction=$(awk -v u="$used" -v t="$total" 'BEGIN {printf "%.2f", u/t}')
detail=$(awk -v u="$used" -v t="$total" 'BEGIN {printf "%.1f / %.1f GB", u/1073741824, t/1073741824}')
notch_result --summary "已刷新" --widget-json "{\"fraction\":$fraction,\"detail\":\"$detail\"}"

widget.html:
(name)
--%
